about: Hand-written sections of Orient and the sources each one describes. The generator flags a section whose sources changed since 'reviewed'. Edit 'watch' by hand (paths, globs, or path::symbol); never edit 'baseline' - run orient.py --mark-reviewed "<DOC>#<Heading>" after re-reading a section. A baseline value of "unknown" means the section's reviewed state could not be reconstructed: on 2026-10-01 these files were edited between auto-commits, so no commit holds the bytes that generation read. Such entries stay flagged until the next review.
